elements.label: Modeling tile grid (Versions and Time, Levels and Dimensions, Accounts, Rules, Sheets)
Page title bar 'Add, Edit, or Delete Version' appears

pattern.description: Screen-recorded page change: after clicking 'Versions and Time', the Modeling tile grid clears to a blank page, then the blue title bar for the 'Add, Edit, or Delete Version' page snaps in while the body is still loading.
pattern.why_premium: Not stylised motion; it is raw app navigation inside a framed browser mock on a brand-blue backdrop. The frame-and-backdrop treatment keeps the raw load readable, but the blank loading state is a missed polish opportunity (a crossfade or skeleton would read more premium).

build_hint.gsap: Hard state swap: gsap.set('.tile-grid', {autoAlpha: 0}); then gsap.set('.page-titlebar', {autoAlpha: 1}) about 2 frames later. To polish, use tl.to('.tile-grid', {autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power1.in'}).fromTo('.page-titlebar', {autoAlpha: 0, y: -8}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Use a step: render the tile grid while frame < cutFrame and the title bar from cutFrame on. For a softer version, set opacity with interpolate(frame, [cut, cut+5], [1, 0]) for the grid and [0, 1] over 8 frames with Easing.out(Easing.cubic) for the bar.

notes: The change is a step page navigation over about 3 frames, not an animation. The cursor (b05) stays in place and is not listed. The cursor click on 'Versions and Time' happened before this burst.
